Casual Scrollers.description: Watch briefly and leave a quick like. Wide reach, shallow involvement.
Casual Scrollers.tip: Hook viewers in the first 2 seconds and add a clear call-to-action to deepen involvement.

Conversation Starters.description: Unusually talkative audience: many comments compared with likes and shares.
Conversation Starters.tip: Ask questions or run polls in the caption, and reply to comments early to keep the thread alive.

Viral Sharers.description: Audience that forwards the post to friends. Strong spread beyond your followers.
Viral Sharers.tip: Make content relatable or useful enough to send to a friend, and add 'share this with...' prompts.

Loyal Fans.description: Watch most of the video and engage steadily. Deep attention, dependable support.
Loyal Fans.tip: Keep serving this audience with series-style content; they respond to consistency.
